clips.title: The story
paras: At Three Corners, roads meet at the western edge of the Redridge Mountains. The routes link Goldshire, Lakeshire, and Darkshire, while Stormwind guards watch for gnolls threatening travelers and supply wagons.

At Three Corners, three roads link the southern settlements of Stormwind. Goldshire lies west in Elwynn Forest, Lakeshire northeast in Redridge, and Darkshire south in Duskwood. Stormwind built Tower Watch at the junction, where guards and scouts try to keep the roads clear. Gnolls from Redridge threaten travelers and supply wagons moving between the regions.
